message.content: Painting the Eiffel Tower would be a massive undertaking. Even with a large crew working around the clock, you’re looking at several years—typically 2–3 years or more—to complete a full repaint, depending on the scope of work, weather conditions, and the number of workers. In practice, the tower is usually only repainted every 7–10 years to preserve its structure and appearance.
